proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / SPECIAL REVENUE FUNDS / FISCAL YEAR ENDING 6/30/11`, PDF pages 66-70 of the FY2011 annual town report (printed folios 63-67). ONE table across five pages, 159 fund rows, against the `GRAND TOTAL` row printed at the foot of page 70. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM AND IN ORDER (rule 13b.4): `PROGRAM NAME` | `FORWARD 7/1/2010` | `TOTAL RECEIPTS` | `TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS` | `BALANCE FWD TO FY'12`. The header block is reprinted at the top of all five pages and was read on each. WHAT PROVES IT, twice over and independently. (1) ALL FOUR money columns foot to the printed GRAND TOTAL to the cent with NO tolerance: 2,688,344.09 / 6,127,226.48 / 6,048,615.90 / 2,766,954.67. (2) EVERY ONE OF THE 159 ROWS closes on the identity the table states about itself -- forward plus receipts less disbursements is the balance carried to FY2012 -- recomputed at the time of transcription with ZERO failures. One wrong digit anywhere breaks a column total and a row at once. THE PER-ROW IDENTITY IS NOT DECLARED AS A `check` ROW, AND THAT IS A LIMIT OF THE VERIFIER RATHER THAN OF THE PAGE. `verify_page_reads.py` parses `row_identity` as either all-plus (`a,b,c=d`) or minus-after-the-first (`a-b-c=d`); it cannot express a MIXED expression, and `forward + receipts - disbursements = balance` is mixed. That is the commonest shape a fund statement takes, so the four printed column totals are what this file leaves under permanent check and the 159 row identities are recorded here as having been computed once. SIGNS ARE THE DOCUMENT'S. Eleven rows print a figure in PARENTHESES and are recorded negative -- Non-Resident Tuition carries forward (7,259.45) and ends (132,906.80), the FY09 FEMA Ice Storm Grant carries forward (150,738.49) and is closed to zero by a receipt of exactly 150,738.49, and 50/50 Grant Sped Tuitions opens at (33,279.48). Read as positives the forward column would foot nowhere near the printed total, so the document settles the convention rather than a choice of ours. ROWS ARE KEYED BY PRINTED POSITION, NEVER BY NAME. `Academic Support` is printed TWICE on page 67 with different figures; `Insurance Recoveries` appears on page 66, `Insurance Recoveries - School` on 67 and `Insurance Recoveries - Police` on 68; `Community Policing` and three dated variants of it sit together on page 68. `fund_number` is the page number and the row's ordinal down that page, so no two rows can collide and no cell can overwrite another -- the failure that silently lost five of sixteen debt issues in another year of this archive. `fund_name` carries the printed section heading (`GENERAL GOVERNMENT`, `SCHOOL DEPARTMENT`, `PUBLIC SAFETY`, `PARKS & RECREATION`, `HIGHWAY DEPT.`, `COUNCIL ON AGING`, `LIBRARY`, `CEMETERIES`, `UNCLASSIFIED`) followed by the printed program name. A section heading is a label on the page and carries no figures; the headings run on across page breaks, so the section of the first rows of pages 67, 68, 69 and 70 is the one last printed before them. A BLANK CELL IS NOT A ZERO. 77 rows print nothing in the receipts column and 62 print nothing in disbursements; those are recorded as no value rather than as 0.00, while a cell that prints `$0.00` is recorded as 0.00. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH, and CLAUDE.md rule 11 is the whole of it: these are the funds the general-fund appropriation schedule on pages 60-65 does not show. School Lunch moves 572,008.13, School Choice 379,696.77 and the Idea Stimulus Program 237,136.06, and none of them appears in the budget the town votes. Nothing here says which of those paid for a post that also appears in the appropriation, which is exactly the mapping this project records as unpublished.
